top_reviews.title: Obsessed! Perfect for an outdoor event in the miami heat
top_reviews.body: Why did you pick this product vs others?: I absolutely loved this romper! It was a last minute purchase for my girlfriend’s firefighter graduation and honestly it was so comfortable, flattering and appropriate. I live in miami and it was an outdoor graduation ceremony so I needed something light and comfortable that still looked nice and classy. This fit the bill perfectly! It’s TTS, I got a size medium and honestly would have been okay with a small which is my usual size since I didn’t want it to be tight but it still looked great! My details: 5’2, 150lbs (with a mom pooch 😅)

top_reviews.title: Almost Perfect: A Flirty Romper with One Fit Flaw
top_reviews.body: This romper is super cute and flirty, with functional tie detailing in the front that adds just the right touch of charm. The fabric feels high quality, and the overall fit was comfortable and true to size. For reference, I’m 5’2”, around 170 lbs, and wear a 36H bra. The romper fit well in the bust and midsection, which is often tricky for me to find. However, I ended up returning it because the shorts flared out a bit at the thighs, which I didn’t find flattering on my frame. That said, if you don’t mind a looser fit on the bottom, it’s a lovely and well-made piece that could definitely work for other body types. Worth a try if you’re into flirty, feminine styles!

top_reviews.title: Super cute and feels amazing
top_reviews.body: Fits very flattering. The quality of the material is very nice and stretchy. Very comfortable for me being 3 months postpartum. Very nice outfit for the summer and breathable.
